sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/whitemountain/recreation/covered-bridge-campground (last updated April 24, 2026; site map image 'Covered Bridge campground site map.jpg'), read 2026-11-23

booking.source: FS page ('Some sites can be reserved online or by calling Toll Free 1-877-444-6777 ... Other sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis'); recreation.gov catalog (29 of the 49 sites listed: 009-017, 029-049) and facility rules (minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14)

fees.source: FS page ('Single Site: $30 per night', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $6 per vehicle per night'); recreation.gov notice ('Site fee includes one RV with tow vehicle'); recreation.gov rates $30 for every site type, 2026 and 2027 peak seasons

sites.source: FS page ('this 49 site campground'); recreation.gov catalog: 21 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites permitting RV/Trailer - 35 ft on 039, 30 ft on 15 sites (009-016, 030, 031, 033-036, 040), 25 ft on 029, 042, 044, 046, 048 - all 21 take 23 ft+, all Back-In; 8 TENT ONLY; the 20 first-come sites (001-008, 018-028) are not catalogued

facilities.source: recreation.gov ('Accessible vault restrooms and a hand pump for water are provided. No showers or dump station are available'); FS page ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site')

values.note: Mid-May to mid-October; recreation.gov sells 2027 nights May 20 to October 11.

season.source: FS page (Seasons of Use 'mid-May - mid-October'); recreation.gov rates ('Peak Season 2027-05-20 to 2027-10-11')

discounts.source: FS page ('Senior and Access pass holders receive a 50% discount')

note: In old hardwood forest by the Albany Covered Bridge, a mile off the Kancamagus Highway and 6 miles from Conway; the Swift River and the Boulder Loop Trail are a short walk. The covered bridge has a 7'9" height limit, so taller rigs come in on Passaconaway Road from West Side Road in Conway. --Claude
summary: FS page + site map + rec.gov facility/rates/catalog: 49 sites, 29 on rec.gov (21 RV-capable, all 23 ft+, max 35, back-in), 20 first-come; $30 + $6 extra vehicle; vault toilets + hand pump, no showers/dump; mid-May to mid-October; 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums. Bridge height limit with the Conway alternate route. Not waterfront confirmed. Phone should be the concessionaire's.
flags: PHONE: 877-444-6777 (recreation.gov call centre) -> 802-289-0970 (recreation.gov: 'For facility specific information, please call (802) 289-0970', the concessionaire). recreation.gov's facility_phone 603-447-2166 (Saco Ranger District) is an alternative.

ACCESS (not a drop): recreation.gov directions 'Vehicles 7'9" or taller are unable to pass through due to height restriction for the covered bridge and must use an alternate route: ... north on Washington Street, which becomes West Side Road. Proceed approximately 1 mile to Passaconaway Road. Turn west on Passaconaway road and follow for 5 miles to the campground.' A 10.5-ft rig takes the Conway route; no 4WD or rig-type warning. Kept in the note. The old note's '3-ton' limit is not on either page read and is dropped.
sites.max_rig_ft 25 -> 35 (catalog: 039 takes 35 ft, 15 sites 30 ft). Every catalogued RV site takes 23 ft+.
booking.fcfs added: some_sites (FS page; the 20 sites 001-008 and 018-028 are not on recreation.gov). Two host sites are marked on the FS site map (by 4 and 38).

Waterfront: not waterfront confirmed. The FS site map puts every site north of Dugway/Passaconaway Road with the Swift River south of the road; Esri 44.0045,-71.2320 shows continuous canopy, the river ~150 m+ south of the nearest catalogued site (rec.gov GIS 44.00336-44.00468).
Pin 44.00315,-71.23219 (= FS lat/long) is ~95 m from the catalogued-site centroid (44.0040,-71.2317), at the entrance; no move.
